about.en: BONE is the governance token of ShibaSwap, the decentralized exchange of the Shiba Inu ecosystem, letting holders vote on proposals through the Doggy DAO; it is also the gas token of Shibarium, Shiba Inu's layer-2 network. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x9813037ee2218799597d83D4a5B6F3b6778218d9.
